addendum.trigger: doc-repo-26 asked whether the boundary-edge writer intrinsically requires the setback-table descriptor, or only road adjacency + parcel geometry -- this determines whether Caldwell/Hays/McLennan are unblocked today independent of the per-city setback-table authoring problem.
addendum.finding: Two separate code paths produce property-boundary-edge atoms, and only one needs the descriptor. (1) depth-warm-city-batch.mjs -> promoteDepthWarmToStorage/emitDepthWarmPromotion (src/depth-warm/promote.ts) is what produced Bastrop's 26,846 atoms and is what the original dispatch pointed at; it hard-requires setback resolution -- resolveSetbackTableRow throws (promote.ts:158-161) before boundary edges are ever emitted, because this path bundles setback-rule + buildable-envelope + boundary-edge into one promotion. (2) boundary-primitive/compute.ts's computeBoundaryEdgeAtoms, driven today only by scripts/boundary-primitive-caldwell.mjs, is a separate lighter path needing only parcel ring geometry, a parcel-adjacency index, and road-node atoms for edge/frontage labeling. Its JurisdictionDescriptor has setbackTable as an explicitly OPTIONAL field (property-reasoning/types.ts:91). When a district has no setback row, resolveDistrictEdgeSetback (resolve-road-class-setback.ts:61-77) returns {kind:'no-setback-row', reason} on that edge's setback field -- an honest absence, not a throw, not a fabricated value. This is mechanically tested, not inferred: boundary-primitive.test.ts (~lines 183-195) asserts every edge's setback is EITHER a resolved feet value OR the honest no-setback-row decline, never anything else.
addendum.unblockAssessment: On the road-adjacency criterion alone (path 2): Caldwell, Hays, McLennan are unblocked -- they have real road-node coverage (13,790 / 40,987 / 28,787) and real ring geometry at scale. Williamson and Travis remain blocked regardless of the join-key/registry-row question, because both have ZERO road-node atoms -- untouched by PR #396/#397.
addendum.notYetTrue: Not claiming path 2 is ready to run as-is. boundary-primitive-caldwell.mjs has its own extra parcel-level gate (line 200-202) that SKIPS a parcel entirely when districtHasSetbackRow is false, rather than letting the engine's own honest-absence path through -- would need removing/changing. Hays and McLennan have no equivalent script at all.
